messages:
kevin_support: FYI escalation from Acme Health — deprovision gap + KMS decryption errors. Customer removed user from Okta at 2026-11-15T01:58:40Z but the user continued to make API calls for ~45m after. Audit shows no 'saml:logout' or 'scim:deactivate' events for that user in the 01:58–02:45 window. Also seeing KMS decrypt failures when reading archived audit blobs: 

sam_security: @kevin_support can you share tenant_id, affected user email, and one example request id? we need that to tie logs to audit pipeline. also any HSM error codes from the customer side?

kevin_support: tenant: acme-health-prod (t-acme-987). user: megan.santos@acmehealth.com. example req id: rq_3a7b9c. Customer forwarded a UI screenshot showing active sessions still listed. They also saw billing charges for 2026-11-15 02:05 which is during the window.

anna_ops: thanks. quick checklist: 
- confirm IdP deprovision webhook delivery to our SCIM endpoint 
- check session revoke queue 
- inspect audit ingest pipeline for missing events 
- verify KMS key used to encrypt archived blobs and any rotation timestamps

lee_sre: ran initial query on session state for t-acme-987, output (sanitized):
```
SELECT session_id, user, created_at, last_seen FROM sessions WHERE tenant_id='t-acme-987' AND user='megan.santos@acmehealth.com' ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 5;
-- results:
-- session_id: s-9f1a.. | created_at: 2026-11-14T22:12:03Z | last_seen: 2026-11-15T02:40:12Z (still active)
```

lee_sre: also pulled audit ingestion slices 2026-11-15T01:50 -> 2026-11-15T03:00. There is a 7m gap in the audit raw stream around 02:02–02:09 where SCIM webhook delivery events normally appear. Need to check the archive decrypt.

deploy-bot: KMS rotation job `kr-20261115-01` completed at 2026-11-15T02:10:12Z on hsm-node-4. Job status: COMPLETED_WITH_WARNINGS. See job log id: klog-7723.

sam_security: that warning is suspicious. If rotation touched the key alias used to encrypt audit archives and one of the HSMs returned a partial failure, some archived blobs may be unreadable until we rewrap with the new key. please paste error snippet from the audit-reader when it attempted to decrypt blob `audit-archive-20261115-0200.rpad`.

kevin_support: customer provided the error: 
```
decrypt failed: KMS_ERR: HSM_DEVICE_ERROR (0x9C) - rewrap failed during key rotation
```

anna_ops: immediate mitigations we should run now: 
1) revoke all active SSO sessions for tenant t-acme-987: `POST /admin/tenants/t-acme-987/sessions/revoke?scope=all` (needs admin service token) 
2) create temporary deny-all policy for legacy SSO assertions: `rbac.policy.create(tenant='t-acme-987', rules=[{'effect':'deny','action':'*','resource':'*','conditions':[{'assertion_version':'saml_v1'}]}])` 
3) re-ingest audit raw if we have backup unencrypted copies; if not, mark archive blob as degraded and escalate to HSM vendor.

lee_sre: ran revoke command (sanitized logs):
```
POST /admin/tenants/t-acme-987/sessions/revoke?scope=all
=> 202 Accepted, job id revoke-20261115-02-14
```
Job enqueued. Also created a canary rule to block new SSO tokens while we investigate.

sam_security: we need to know whether the missing SCIM event was lost upstream (IdP) or dropped by our webhook handler. kevin, can you share Okta delivery logs from the customer? even a screenshot of the delivery history helps.

kevin_support: customer attached Okta delivery history — shows 200 response for the SCIM payload at 01:58:41Z. Our webhook handler logs show 200 as well, but the audit pipeline fn-insert step returned a transient DB timeout for that payload at 01:58:43Z: `pg: canceling statement due to statement timeout`. Looks like the audit insert retried but the retry path didn't write the 'scim:deactivate' event.

anna_ops: that explains the missing audit record. two parallel issues: (A) transient DB timeout caused SCIM deprovision event to be dropped, (B) KMS/HSM rewrap warnings made some archived audit blobs unreadable. Both combined make the user look active in our system and also prevent post-facto proof in audit logs.

sam_security: action items: 
- sam_security to open HSM vendor ticket with job id `kr-20261115-01` and provide blob id + error code (ETA: 2h) 
- lee_sre to run DB health check and increase pg write timeout for audit-insert pipeline + surface retry metrics (ETA: 1h) 
- anna_ops to draft customer communication with rollback/mitigation steps + timeline (ETA: 45m) 
- kevin_support to collect Okta webhook delivery details and billing artifacts for the usage spike (ETA: 30m)

kevin_support: noted. customer asks for a timeline and whether we can backfill missing scim event so they have an audit trail for compliance.

anna_ops: we can backfill in the audit index if we have the original SCIM payload. If we only have Okta delivery logs and our webhook request id, we can synthesize an audit entry marked `synthetic: true` with `source: okta-webhook` and include the raw delivery payload. That will satisfy audit retention checks for compliance while we recover the original archive. we'll flag it clearly.

lee_sre: putting the backfill job in a controlled queue to avoid duplicates. backfill job id: backfill-t-acme-987-20261115-03, will include event.original_request_id = rq_3a7b9c and note `replay_reason: dropped_on_insert`.

deploy-bot: created incident task INC-20261115-77 and assigned to triage channel.

kevin_support: customer updated, appreciates the revoke and canary policy. they requested interim confirmation once backfill completes so they can close their internal ticket.

sam_security: I'll open vendor escalation now. tagging @hsm-vendor-contact. :eyes:

anna_ops: good work team. I'll own the customer comms. Post updates here and paste the backfill success/failure.

lee_sre: will paste backfill result when done. current ETA ~ 38m.

kevin_support: thanks all. I'll keep this thread updated with any customer evidence.
